learnable.stage_pair_cost: MLP with LayerNorm; learned via host objective
learnable.evidence_gate: pair/stage MLP -> sigmoid; row/column means -> normalized evidence marginals
learnable.wsi_gain,omics_gain: scalar parameters, tanh bounded; raw init .05, effective about .04996
learnable.wsi_prototypes,omics_prototypes: learnable only when token count exceeds slot_budget and pooling is used; inactive for SlotSPE direct slots

fixed: Sinkhorn iteration rule; differentiable but no independent solver parameters
slotspe_insertion: pre-hook of original cross_attention; its two incoming full slot tensors are updated; self-attention, decoder and reconstruction branches retain original slots
independent: balanced: a b^T (same reference marginals, total 1); optional UOT uses realized r c^T / m, retaining realized mass
attribution_boundary: Across separately trained arms marginal parameters may differ. Same-checkpoint independent evaluation holds learned parameters and input fixed; learned OT marginals match references only within solver tolerance.
capacity_boundary: Independent instantiates same nominal parameters but balanced stage-pair cost has no objective path, and native-slot pooling prototypes are inactive. Do not call the effective trainable capacity identical.
scientific_question: Does pair-specific correspondence provide value beyond sending the same marginal-weighted opposite-modality mean to every slot?
answer_now: patient evidence insufficient; interfaces/synthetic checks do not establish benefit, local correspondence or OT superiority over attention
